missions.title: Banquet after Dark
missions.description: M16A1 has been missing for a week, but RO and SOP2 are still fervently searching for her. However, the Commander has left the base after receiving an urgent assignment...

missions.title: Probe
missions.description: Things between RO and SOP2 are pretty awkward as they're still trying to get comfortable around each other. I hope the Commander that's at the banquet right now will be able to assist them in time...

missions.title: Forum
missions.description: RO reports that SOP2 is still a bit mentally unstable. Wow, I can tell SOP2 is really restraining herself compared to previous records.

missions.title: Double Search
missions.description: RO has urgently reported the incident that had just happened, but it seems like SOP2 has a plan of her own...

missions.title: Prelude
missions.description: The Commander complained that the food at the banquet was not as good as he thought it would be, but look at me! I had to eat take-out on base! Meanwhile, it seems like RO just encountered another new Sangvis Ringleader. This overtime is killing me!

missions.title: Breakthrough
missions.description: Newly encountered Sangvis Ringleader "Judge" is hunting down RO and SOP2. It's up to them themselves to come up with an escape plan…

missions.title: Hawk and Hound I
missions.description: RO's Report: SOP2 once again finds herself in trouble as we are pursuing Judge. I hope reinforcements from the Commander will arrive in time…

missions.title: Hawk and Hound II
missions.description: RO's Report: The Commander said that the banquet he's at right now is a precursor of a large event to come, but the immediate focus is still on the little incidents around us right now…

missions.title: Hawk and Hound III
missions.description: RO's Report: SOP2 began opening up to me...we'll get along well, and things will slowly turn out for the better...I'm sure of it…

missions.title: Hawk and Hound IV
missions.description: RO's Report: We're right on Judge's tail! If we had some more help right now…

missions.title: The Way Back is Paved with Light I
missions.description: Script Scene 1: Take some footages of engaging S.F. in battle at the predetermined location. Looking good so far. Garand.

missions.title: The Way Back is Paved with Light II
missions.description: Script Scene 2: M3 and AK【scratched】 are cast as M4 and M16. AK-47 can't make it, so we have to resort to our backup plan... Not that I know what that is. T65.

missions.title: The Way Back is Paved with Light III
missions.description: Script 【scratched】 【scratched】. We won't need a script anymore. M16 is back. T77.

missions.title: The Way Back is Paved with Light IV
missions.description: 【scratched】. Even if it's the truth, it has no choice but to compromise with us.
